_comment: OFW Support Center directory. Numbers and links are for well-known Philippine government and support services — members should verify local numbers for their host country. Edit this file to add country-specific and church-specific contacts.

emergency.title: If you are in immediate danger
emergency.note: Call the local emergency number of the country you are in first (for example 999 in Hong Kong/UK, 995/999 in Singapore, 911 in Saudi Arabia/UAE/US, 112 in most of Europe). Then contact your nearest Philippine Embassy or Consulate.

crisis.name: National Center for Mental Health Crisis Hotline (Philippines)
crisis.detail: 24/7 free and confidential emotional support in Filipino and English.

crisis.name: In Touch Community Services Crisis Line (Philippines)
crisis.detail: Free 24/7 crisis intervention and emotional support.

crisis.name: Find a helpline in your host country
crisis.detail: Directory of verified emotional-support helplines in over 130 countries.

government.name: Department of Migrant Workers (DMW)
government.detail: One-stop agency for OFW concerns: contracts, complaints, repatriation, welfare assistance.

government.name: OWWA — Overseas Workers Welfare Administration
government.detail: Membership benefits, welfare assistance, scholarships, reintegration programs.

government.name: Philippine Embassies & Consulates Directory
government.detail: Find the address and hotline of the Philippine Embassy or Consulate nearest you. Ask for ATN (Assistance-to-Nationals) or the Migrant Workers Office (MWO/POLO).

government.name: OWWA Uwian Na (Repatriation Assistance)
government.detail: Help for distressed OFWs who need to come home.
government.contact: Via OWWA hotline 1348 or your MWO/POLO office

government.name: SSS for OFWs
government.detail: Continue your Social Security contributions while abroad — pension, loans, benefits.

government.name: Pag-IBIG Overseas Program
government.detail: Savings and housing loans for OFWs.

support.name: Mission for Migrant Workers (Hong Kong)
support.detail: Free assistance for migrant domestic workers in crisis in Hong Kong: shelter, case help, counseling.

support.name: HOME — Humanitarian Organization for Migration Economics (Singapore)
support.detail: Help for migrant domestic workers in Singapore: shelter, helpdesk, training.

support.name: Migrante International
support.detail: Global grassroots organization of overseas Filipinos with chapters in many countries.

support.name: Blas F. Ople Policy Center
support.detail: NGO assisting distressed OFWs and victims of illegal recruitment and trafficking.

support.name: IOM Global Assistance Directory
support.detail: International Organization for Migration — support for migrants worldwide.

church.name: FLCC — Filipino Language Christian Congregation
church.detail: Our home church family, led by Rev. Jopet Alim. Worship service every Friday, 10:00 AM, at the National Evangelical Church in Kuwait compound.
church.contact: Ask your fellowship leader for directions and details

church.name: FLCC — Virtual Church
church.detail: Led by Pastor Anson Dionisio. Every Sunday and Wednesday, 10:30 PM Kuwait time · K.S.A. every Saturday, 10:30 AM.

offday.title: Ideas for your day off
offday.note: Your rest day is precious. Even one meaningful connection can refill your heart for weeks.

ideas.title: Join a worship service or Bible study
ideas.detail: Online or in person — see the Faith tab for this week's schedule.

ideas.title: Meet kababayans for a meal
ideas.detail: Cook or share Filipino food with friends — lutong bahay heals homesickness.

ideas.title: Schedule a long video call home
ideas.detail: Not the rushed weekday kind — a slow Sunday call with the whole family.

ideas.title: Go somewhere green
ideas.detail: A park, a waterfront, a walk. Sunlight and open space lift a tired heart.

ideas.title: Feed your mind
ideas.detail: A free online course, a book, or a skill for your future — invest one hour in you.

ideas.title: Encourage another OFW
ideas.detail: Message someone who might be lonelier than you. Ministering to others heals us too.

ideas.title: Write in your journal
ideas.detail: Ten quiet minutes with your own thoughts — see the Journal tab.

ideas.title: Real rest
ideas.detail: A nap without an alarm. Rest is not wasted time; it is maintenance for the soul.
